title: MEV / first-claimer front-run of winner-take-all nudge pot
description: The nudge payout is full-balance, winner-take-all, with permissionless entry and a caller-chosen recipient. The first qualifying caller in a block takes the whole pot. A searcher can observe an honest qualifying batchMint in the mempool, copy it with recipient = searcher and a higher priority fee, land first, and scoop the entire pot. Re-evaluated this run after story-015's minReward fix.
impact: PARTIALLY MITIGATED, residual still open at Medium. story-015's minReward correctly closes the loser-overpay leg: a sniped honest caller now reverts atomically (via the minReward slippage guard) instead of minting for a gone reward. However minReward does NOT stop the front-runner from WINNING the winner-take-all balance-based pot. The MEV capture root cause persists: a searcher still scoops the entire pot ahead of the honest qualifying minter; the honest user's protected tx merely reverts rather than minting for nothing.
attackPath: 1. Honest user broadcasts a qualifying batchMint (count >= nudgeSize) with recipient = self and a minReward slippage bound.
2. A searcher observes the mempool, copies the call with recipient = searcher and a higher priority fee.
3. Searcher's tx lands first; the winner-take-all full-balance payout transfers the whole pot to the searcher (MEV capture leg -- STILL OPEN).
4. The honest user's tx now reverts on the minReward guard instead of minting for an empty pot (loser-overpay leg -- MITIGATED by story-015).
recommendation: Remove the winner-take-all mempool race at the root: (1) bind the nudge recipient to msg.sender; (2) use per-spend accounting so the nudge accrues to the actual spender rather than the first to clear a shared full-balance gate; (3) commit-reveal or batched settlement to remove the front-runnable single-block race. minReward (story-015) is a partial slippage protection only and does not address the MEV capture leg.

metadata.verdict: PARTIALLY MITIGATED by story-015 (minReward closes loser-overpay leg); MEV capture leg STILL OPEN. Not a regression (never marked fixed). Not re-reported as new (residual of acknowledged).
